info.name: Export all subject data from Zoho Desk

items.docs: This API exports data related to the subject, from your Zoho Desk portal.

params.name: module
params.description: Name of the modules from which the resources must be fetched. Values allowed are @tickets@ and @contacts@. If you want to fetch resources from both modules, pass the value @allEntities@.

items.docs: This API fetchs possible fileds list and conditions

params.name: include
params.description: Additional information related to the request. Values allowed are: @createdBy@ and @modifiedBy@. You can pass multiple values by separating them using commas in the API request.

items.docs: This API fetches the details of a particular SAR.

info.name: Erase all subject data from Zoho Desk

items.docs: This API erases data related to the subject, from your Zoho Desk portal.

params.name: duration
params.description: Period in which the requests were made. Values allowed are: @TODAY@, @LAST_24_HOURS@, @LAST_7_DAYS@, @LAST_30_DAYS@, @CURRENT_WEEK@, and @CURRENT_MONTH@.

params.name: include
params.description: Additional information related to the requests. Values allowed are: @createdBy@ and @modifiedBy@. You can pass multiple values by separating them using commas in the API request.

params.name: contactEmailId
params.description: Email ID of the contact who made the request.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of requests to list. The default value is @10@ and the maximum value supported is @100@.

params.name: from
params.description: Index number, starting from which the requests must be fetched.

params.name: status
params.description: Processing status of the request. Values allowed are: @INITIATED@, @INPROGRESS@, @COMPLETED@, @CANCELED@, @EXPORTED@, @PARTIALLY_COMPLETED@, @PARTIALLY_EXPORTED@ and @FAILED@. You can pass multiple values by separating them using commas in the API request.

items.docs: This API lists a particular number of subject access requests, based on the limit specified.
